minimum_data_bundle: verified transformer–bus–EVSE mapping; ambient temperature; transformer thermal measurement; transformer current; documented thermal restriction/reason; charger actual AC power/request/limit
conditional_data: vehicle SOC and transport required/delivered service if mobility consequence is claimed
what_missing_prevents: No source restriction log or receiver response means causal mechanism unsupported

minimum_data_bundle: verified transformer–bus–EVSE mapping; EVSE internal temperature; thermal derating flag/reason; charger request and AC power; non-EV feeder load; transformer loading and thermal state
conditional_data: SOC, charging schedule, cooling telemetry, grid dispatcher overrides
what_missing_prevents: No thermal cause log and AC response means direction unsupported

minimum_data_bundle: measured heat forcing and relevant physical state over valid clock; initial condition; source-qualified parameter identity; component model and dimensions
conditional_data: SOC, battery temperature, slow degradation only if dynamically necessary

minimum_data_bundle: defined service requirement with time and unit; served electricity same boundary; event timings; observation quality
conditional_data: recovery event and intervention log if recovery claimed
what_missing_prevents: No required-service baseline or delivered-service observation

minimum_data_bundle: defined required and delivered mobility in same unit and interval; charging availability; operational schedule
conditional_data: battery SOC, available energy, bus route and missed departures when relevant
what_missing_prevents: Charging power alone does not prove mobility service consequence

minimum_data_bundle: independent measured observations, exact source/equipment/conditions, frozen calibration/validation split, uncertainty and comparison metric
conditional_data: multiple equipment sites and ambient ranges for transferability assessment
what_missing_prevents: Simulated or fitting data alone cannot establish empirical validity

minimum_data_bundle: matched reference and heat-only cases; independently defined and sourced environmental/economic/social indicator
conditional_data: functional unit when appropriate and valid emission/cost factors
what_missing_prevents: Cannot infer external indicator from resilience score alone
admission_decision: OPEN until source and boundary validated

minimum_data_bundle: matched heat-only and heat-plus-action cases; same indicator, units, boundary, horizon
what_missing_prevents: Effectiveness alone is not sustainability improvement
